name: Off-creek pond (recommended) · ~0.6 ML
notes: A dug pond about 28 × 18 m and 2 m deep (about 0.6 ML) on the creek flats near the house, filled by a small diversion or pump from the creek rather than built across it. Out of the flood channel, easy to reach, and good for irrigation, stock water and fire-fighting. Keep the creek setback and check NSW water rules (harvestable rights) before digging.
